title: Antibody-mediated encephalitides: distinct diseases with transdisciplinary implications
title_zh: 抗体介导的脑炎：具有跨学科意义的独特疾病
abstract: The discovery of antibody-mediated glial and neuronal disorders has transformed the diagnosis and treatment of neurological diseases previously considered idiopathic or not recognised as immune-mediated. Antibody-mediated disorders targeting glial aquaporin-4 and myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein are distinct nosological entities, defined by specific targets, mechanisms, syndromes, and therapeutic implications. By contrast, antibody-mediated disorders targeting neuronal antigens (ie, autoimmune encephalitides) are still frequently analysed collectively, with data from different disorders pooled as if they represent a single disease rather than distinct entities. Evidence from anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, anti-LGI1 encephalitis, and anti-IgLON5 disease (used here as exemplars of autoimmune encephalitides) indicates that individual autoimmune encephalitides differ in demographics, triggers, mechanisms, clinical manifestations, post-acute trajectories, and treatment requirements. The broad, heterogeneous presentations of autoimmune encephalitides require coordinated multidisciplinary care within and beyond neurology, involving specialists in paediatrics, infectious diseases, epilepsy, movement disorders, sleep medicine, intensive care, cognitive rehabilitation, and other relevant disciplines. Such interdisciplinary collaboration facilitates the recognition of new diseases and elucidation of the causes of previously unclassified disorders. Improving patient care requires not only aetiological and mechanistic insight to enable development of targeted therapies but also strengthened cross-specialty expertise to optimise diagnosis and management.
abstract_zh: 抗体介导的胶质细胞和神经元疾病的发现，改变了先前被视为特发性或未被认定为免疫介导的神经疾病的诊断与治疗。针对胶质细胞水通道蛋白‑4（aquaporin‑4）和髓鞘寡突胶质细胞糖蛋白（myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein）的抗体介导疾病是独立的疾病实体，具有特定的靶点、机制、综合征和治疗意义。相比之下，针对神经元抗原的抗体介导疾病（即自身免疫性脑炎）仍常被合并分析，来自不同疾病的数据被视为单一疾病而非独立实体。来自抗NMDA受体脑炎、抗LGI1脑炎和抗IgLON5疾病（在此作为自身免疫性脑炎示例）的证据表明，个体自身免疫性脑炎在人口学、诱因、机制、临床表现、急性后轨迹和治疗需求方面存在差异。自身免疫性脑炎的广泛且异质的表现需要在神经科内外进行协调的多学科护理，涉及儿科、传染病学、癫痫学、运动障碍学、睡眠医学、重症医学、认知康复学及其他相关学科。跨学科合作有助于识别新疾病并阐明先前未分类疾病的病因。提升患者护理不仅需要因果和机制洞察以开发靶向疗法，还需要加强跨专业专长以优化诊断和管理。
